outcome: Association between undetected SGA and abnormal admCTG
Composite severe adverse neonatal outcome (Apgar score <4 at 5 minutes, hypoxic-ischaemic encephalopathy grade of 2-3, neonatal seizures, neonatal death)
cohort: The study included a cohort of 127,461 deliveries from a low-risk population in four hospitals in Stockholm-Gotland, Sweden, between 2012 and 2020.
finding: In this low-risk population, undetected small-for-gestational-age fetuses were more prone to having abnormal admission cardiotocography and had a substantially higher risk of severe adverse neonatal outcomes.
birth_weight: SGA was defined as a birthweight at or below the tenth centile and at or below the third centile for gestational age; overall birth weight distribution of the cohort is not specified.
gest_age: SGA was defined as a birthweight at or below the tenth centile and at or below the third centile for gestational age; overall gestational age distribution of the cohort is not specified.
